tagline: Teach the AI how you write — from your documents, LinkedIn and X history — then rewrite any draft so it sounds like you, for a specific audience and platform.
summary: Make It Sound Like Me (MISLM) builds an **About me** voice profile. You upload documents (txt, md, docx, pdf) and pick what each one is (bio, how I talk, …); Claude extracts structured facts. It can also scrape your LinkedIn and X posts and comments through Apify and summarize how you speak on each platform into versioned speaking guidance.

With the profile in place you paste a draft into **Content**, choose a writing audience, a platform (LinkedIn or X) and an approach, and get a structured, voice-matched rewrite to compare against your original. For X drafts it can also suggest tweets and refine them from your feedback. Other Luckee apps (e.g. TwitterX Manager) call it through an integrations API to rewrite text in your voice.
audience: Founders and consultants who post on LinkedIn and X and want AI help that doesn't sound generic.
You have writing samples (bios, posts, docs) the AI can learn from.
You use other Luckee content tools that should share one voice profile.
notFor: Scheduling or publishing posts — it writes and rewrites; posting happens elsewhere.
Multi-tenant SaaS today — product data moved to single-tenant local storage (one instance key per install).
Ghostwriting without your input — it needs your own samples to work well.

capabilities.title: About me profile
capabilities.detail: `/about-me` tabs for profile facts, documents, overview and social handles; **Analyze** extracts each saved document with Claude (deferred, not on upload).

capabilities.title: LinkedIn and X import
capabilities.detail: Apify scrapes your LinkedIn posts/comments and X posts; **Summarize** produces versioned per-platform speaking guidance and talk topics.

capabilities.title: Writing audiences
capabilities.detail: `/audiences` and `/audience-detail-page` define who you're writing for; every compare needs one.

capabilities.title: Content compare
capabilities.detail: `/content` and `/content-detail-page`: paste a draft, pick audience, platform and approach, and get a structured rewrite next to your original.

capabilities.title: Suggested tweets
capabilities.detail: Generate post ideas per draft; `/suggested-tweet-detail-page` regenerates one from feedback, and later batches learn from those corrections.

capabilities.title: AI provider picker
capabilities.detail: Choose Anthropic or Gemini for X features.

capabilities.title: Integrations API
capabilities.detail: `/api/integrations/create-content` lets other tools rewrite text in your voice, logged to a separate ledger.

capabilities.title: AI costs, auth and waitlist
capabilities.detail: `/ai-costs` ledger view; Supabase email/Google sign-in; production waitlist protected by reCAPTCHA.

components.name: Web app
components.owns: Landing, auth, dashboard, About me, audiences, content, suggested tweets, AI costs. Calls the API at `NEXT_PUBLIC_CMS_URL` with the Supabase JWT.

components.name: API
components.stack: Express + TypeScript, Anthropic SDK, Google GenAI, Supabase JS, `mammoth`, `pdf-parse`, `multer`
components.owns: Document parsing and extraction, social scrape/summarize, content compare, post suggestions, integrations API, waitlist. Verifies Supabase JWTs. Reads/writes product data via storage invoke.
components.doesNotOwn: Relational product data since the single-tenant cutover — that's in storage.

components.name: Storage server
components.owns: `make_it_sound_like_me` Postgres: About me, content, audiences, AI ledgers, integration ledger, `dispatcher_exposed_endpoints`.

dataFlow: You sign in with Supabase; the web app sends the JWT to the API.
Uploaded documents go to the Supabase Storage bucket `about-me-sources`; **Analyze** extracts text (mammoth / pdf-parse) and sends it to Claude.
Social import calls Apify actors for LinkedIn and X, then Claude or Gemini summarizes speaking style.
Content compare builds a prompt from About me, platform guidance, audience and approach, and returns structured JSON.
Every AI round trip writes a request / response / exchange ledger. Relational data goes to storage (`MISLM_STORAGE_DIRECT_URL` or the main gateway), scoped by `MISLM_LOCAL_INSTANCE_KEY`.

trust.title: Browser
trust.detail: Supabase anon key, reCAPTCHA site key and the API URL.

trust.title: API
trust.detail: Supabase service role, Anthropic, Gemini, Apify and reCAPTCHA secrets; storage/gateway secret.

trust.title: Storage host
trust.detail: Only place with `DATABASE_URL`; accepts callers with `STORAGE_DISPATCHER_SECRET`.

trust.title: Supabase
trust.detail: Still holds auth, the `about-me-sources` file bucket and the waitlist.

trust.title: Third parties
trust.detail: Your documents and posts go to Anthropic/Gemini; Apify scrapes your public profiles.

commonTasks.title: First-time setup
steps: Run **Setup** in Hub (add the storage repo path to hub.local.json first — see Hub notes).
On the **Storage Express** repo, **Set up local database** to create `make_it_sound_like_me` and apply `migrations/`.

On the API set `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `APIFY_API_TOKEN`, plus `MISLM_STORAGE_DIRECT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3083` and `MISLM_STORAGE_DISPATCHER_SECRET`.
On the web set `NEXT_PUBLIC_CMS_URL` to the API's port (3071) and the Supabase public vars.

commonTasks.title: Build your voice profile
steps: Fill in profile facts and upload documents on `/about-me`, choosing a type for each.
Click **Analyze** per document, then generate the overview.
Add LinkedIn and X handles, import, and run **Summarize** for each platform.

commonTasks.title: Rewrite a draft
commonTasks.when: You have a post to polish.
steps: Create an audience on `/audiences` if you don't have one.
On `/content`, paste the draft, choose audience, platform and approach, and run compare.
For X, generate suggested tweets and refine with feedback.

commonTasks.title: Import legacy data from Supabase
steps: Run the import from the dashboard (About me import status) and check counts.

troubleshooting.fix: No Supabase session reached the API, or the API's Supabase URL/service key doesn't match the web project.
Storage unreachable or secret mismatch: `curl http://127.0.0.1:3083/api/storage/health` and compare `MISLM_STORAGE_DISPATCHER_SECRET`.
Scanned/image-only PDFs have no text for `pdf-parse`; export a text PDF or paste the text.
Set `RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY` on the API and the matching site key on the web.

glossary.definition: Your voice profile: facts, documents, overview and per-platform speaking guidance.
Who a draft is for; required for every compare.
A built-in writing style/structure applied to a draft (separate from audience and platform).
AI log for external rewrite calls, kept apart from your own content compares.

hubNotes: hub.local.json has no `storageExpressDir`, though `make-it-sound-like-me-storage-express-server` is cloned at `~/github/makeitsoundlikeme/` — add it so Hub can run storage.
The web `.env.example` sets `NEXT_PUBLIC_CMS_URL=http://localhost:3072`, which is the web's own Hub port; the API runs on 3071.
The latest web commit removed the code-commit-summary content features; express ADRs 030–032 describe code that's no longer used by the UI.
Web and API READMEs are still templates; the ADRs (web 015–035, express 011–035) are the real docs.
